headlines.title: 한국판 IRA 내년 도입 …반도체·2차전지 등 생산 세액공제

key_headlines.title: Record tax revenue expected to exceed 500 trillion won amid semiconductor boom
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's first-half tax revenue reached 223 trillion won, up 33 trillion from the previous year, with projections for the full year approaching 450 trillion won and potentially breaking 500 trillion won next year driven by Samsung and SK Hynix corporate tax prepayments.

key_headlines.title: July consumer inflation drops to 2% range after three months as oil prices stabilize
key_headlines.summary: Consumer price inflation fell to 2.8% year-over-year in July from 3% in the previous two months, aided by government oil price controls and international oil price declines, while core inflation rose to a 2-year-7-month high.

key_headlines.title: Core inflation rises amid strong economic growth, putting pressure on consecutive rate hikes
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's core inflation reached the highest level in 2 years and 7 months despite overall consumer inflation cooling, leading the central bank to seriously consider consecutive interest rate increases despite concerns over real estate market stability.

key_headlines.title: Government introduces tax deductions for domestic AI and semiconductor production
key_headlines.summary: The 2026 tax reform plan establishes new domestic production tax credits for AI, robots, semiconductors, and secondary batteries, with small modular reactors receiving up to 50% R&D tax deductions as part of national strategic technology initiatives.

key_headlines.title: US intervenes in currency markets for first time in 28 years to support yen
key_headlines.summary: The US engaged in foreign exchange market intervention to purchase yen and sell dollars in response to rising US Treasury yields, stabilizing the won-dollar exchange rate around 1,429-1,430 won as regional geopolitical risks ease.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing a semiconductor-driven tax revenue boom, with first-half national tax revenue reaching 223 trillion won, marking a 33 trillion won increase from the previous year. The government projects year-end revenues could approach 450 trillion won, with potential to surpass 500 trillion won in 2027 driven by major chipmakers' tax prepayments. Simultaneously, the government unveiled comprehensive 2026 tax reform measures including new domestic production tax credits for AI, semiconductors, and secondary batteries to strengthen economic security. These developments come amid mixed inflation signals, with consumer price inflation cooling to 2.8% in July but core inflation hitting 2-year-7-month highs, creating policy dilemmas for monetary authorities.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea faces a complex policy environment as consumer inflation moderated to 2.8% in July from 3% in prior months, primarily due to declining oil prices and government price stabilization measures. However, core inflation rose to the highest level in 2 years and 7 months, driven by cost pressures and expanding durable goods prices, prompting serious consideration of consecutive interest rate hikes. The August consumer price inflation is expected to rise above July levels due to base effects from telecommunications company discounts in the prior year. Government fiscal measures include the newly announced 2026 tax reform emphasizing domestic production incentives and regional development, particularly for AI and strategic technology sectors, while introducing stricter taxation on non-resident single-home owners to address housing market concerns.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean equity markets showed mixed performance with the KOSPI gaining strength amid declining oil prices and falling Treasury yields, though individual stocks like Hyundai Motor and Samsung Biologics posted losses. The KOSDAQ advanced over 3% with institutional selling creating mixed KOSPI trading patterns. The won-dollar exchange rate stabilized around 1,429-1,430 won following US foreign exchange intervention to support the yen, marking America's first currency market intervention in 28 years. Market participants anticipate the August US non-farm payroll data will be crucial, as weaker-than-expected employment figures could ease interest rate hike concerns and provide support to equity markets, while SK Hynix share deposit receipts and coordinated US-Japan currency intervention continue to underpin the Korean won.
sections.Industry & Technology: The domestic automotive industry showed strong adoption of eco-friendly vehicles, with 60% of newly registered vehicles in the first half being electric or hybrid models, though concerns mount over Chinese electric vehicle market share gains following Geely-Volvo's rapid expansion. Samsung Energy Solutions secured US patents for FF-PCB technology applicable to energy storage systems and electric vehicle battery packs, positioning the company in the competitive global battery market. Shipbuilding and steel industries are facing unprecedented challenges from record heat waves exceeding 40 degrees Celsius, forcing operational adjustments and work hour modifications. Konkuk University researchers developed multi-functional thermal management materials to prevent electric vehicle battery fires, while industry observers note that China, led by BYD's competitive pricing, has surpassed Germany as the leading imported vehicle brand in Korea.
sections.Real Estate: Real estate experts anticipate significant increases in property listings before 2028 when long-term ownership tax benefits are scheduled to decrease, potentially affecting ultra-high-value and elderly single-home owners seeking tax optimization strategies. The 2026 tax reform introduces substantial changes including reduced long-term ownership deductions and increased holding taxes on non-resident single-home owners, expected to push property owners toward residential use and increase household debts. New lending restrictions targeting non-resident single-home owners will limit fresh secured loan origination and restrict existing loan renewals, potentially worsening the rental crisis by reducing jeonse (lease deposit) supply. Regional property demand may concentrate in 30-pyeong apartment markets in areas like Mapo and Seongdong as investors respond to tax changes, while property tax burdens are set to rise significantly as Korea's real estate tax reaches approximately 3.0% of GDP, already double the OECD average of 1.6%.
sections.International Economy: The US stock market rallied to record highs with the Dow Jones reaching all-time peaks and NASDAQ advancing 2% as oil prices plummeted, creating relief from inflation concerns and reducing expectations for aggressive Federal Reserve tightening. The Fed's recent decision to hold rates steady has kept market focus on September's FOMC meeting, where CME FedWatch data shows a 66.5% probability of at least 25 basis points of rate increases. The Trump administration faces legal challenges from 25 US states over the constitutionality of Section 301 tariffs on major trading partners, with courts examining whether executive tariff authority exceeds constitutional limits. The US foreign exchange intervention supporting the yen marks the first such action in 28 years, reflecting concerns over rising US Treasury yields and supporting allied currency stability. Japan has formally protested through diplomatic channels the Trump administration's unauthorized use of Pokemon and Naruto characters in immigration enforcement materials, highlighting tensions between trade policies and intellectual property protection.
sections.AI & Economy: President Lee Seung-yeol emphasized that Korea must undertake aggressive investment and rapid execution strategies to capitalize on the AI-driven industrial transformation reshaping the global economy, advocating for diversified export markets and supply chain resilience. The government's 2026 tax reform establishes substantial tax incentives for domestic AI and semiconductor production, with regional companies receiving preferential treatment to encourage decentralized development away from Seoul metropolitan concentration. Copper prices surged significantly as markets recognized its critical role in AI infrastructure development, particularly for data center power grid construction and electric vehicle manufacturing which requires 3-4 times more copper than gasoline vehicles. MIT research and venture capital activity demonstrate that companies reorganizing around AI capabilities have achieved doubled revenue growth, indicating fundamental shifts in organizational design and business models. The Haenam AI Center groundbreaking promises to deploy 15,000 GPUs, addressing immediate data science talent shortages and creating employment opportunities for job seekers specializing in artificial intelligence technologies.
sections.Others: The US Democratic Party gained polling advantages over Republicans in economic management perception for the first time in a decade, with President Trump's approval rating declining to 35% amid Iranian conflict-related oil price spikes affecting household budgets. Denmark implemented expanded conscription requirements effective August 3rd to counter Russian threats and respond to Trump administration pressure, requiring even second-in-line royal heirs to complete 11 months of military service. South Korean beauty brands successfully concluded 8 million dollar export contracts in China by leveraging government trade support centers that provide market research, buyer identification, transaction facilitation, and post-contract management services beyond traditional business card networking. The Korean automotive parts sector is accelerating robot market expansion following US FCC restrictions on Chinese robot imports, providing competitive advantages to companies with existing local manufacturing operations. President Lee emphasized the critical importance of securing stable power and water supply for three major infrastructure projects and called for regional economic development incentives as Korea implements its AI-centered economic policy transformation.
